canon.note: Hysilens is a Nihility (Physical) DoT enabler. Basic Aeolian Mode is a 2-hit physical attack (+1 SP, +20 Energy). Skill Overtone Hum is an AoE physical hit that also raises DMG taken on enemies (hys_vuln). Ultimate Maelstrom Rhapsody detonates all DoTs at 150% (The Bubble of Banquets), deals AoE physical DMG and deploys the Maelstrom Rhapsody Zone (hys_zone / hys_zone_def DEF-down / hys_zone_atk) for a few turns. Talent Sirenic Serenade: every ally attack has a base chance to inflict one of WindShear/Burn/Shock/Bleed (Bleed = 20% of target Max HP capped). While the Zone is active each DoT tick also spawns a Zone Physical DoT (per-turn capped). A2 The Fiddle of Pearls is EHR-gated (needs >60% EHR).

fixtures.env: Hysilens E0 solo vs a Physical-weak Elite, 4 cycles - Basic Aeolian Mode, Skill Overtone Hum (+vuln), Ultimate Maelstrom Rhapsody (detonate + Zone), Talent DoT on every attack and the Zone Physical DoT on every enemy DoT tick.

Hysilens E6 solo vs a Physical-weak Elite, 4 cycles - E1 gives all allies +16% DoT dealt and a second coexisting Talent DoT instance, E4 turns the Zone into an All-Type RES -20% on enemies, E6 raises the Zone DoT multiplier x1.2.

requirements.claim: Basic ATK Aeolian Mode is a 2-hit physical attack (labels Aeolian Mode (1/2) and Aeolian Mode (2/2)).
Skill Overtone Hum (132002) is an AoE physical hit.
Ultimate Maelstrom Rhapsody (132003) is an AoE physical hit.
A1 The Bubble of Banquets: casting the Ultimate detonates all DoTs on each enemy (label The Bubble of Banquets).
Talent Sirenic Serenade inflicts one of WindShear/Burn/Shock/Bleed on the attacked enemy (DOT_APPLIED).
The Talent infection is surfaced as a trace line 'Hysilens Talent: <kind> on <target>'.
The Ultimate deploys the Maelstrom Rhapsody Zone, marked on every enemy (hys_zone).
While the Zone is active enemies suffer a DEF reduction (hys_zone_def defRed).
Zone deployment is surfaced as a trace line 'Hysilens Deploys Zone +1 SP'.
While the Zone is active every enemy DoT tick spawns a Zone Physical DoT (log 'Hysilens Zone Phys DoT on <target> (+1)').
Skill Overtone Hum raises the target's DMG taken (hys_vuln vulnAll).
E1 You Ask Why Hearts Cry grants all allies +16% DoT dealt (hys_e1 boost:dot 0.16).
E4 Lo, How Time Flows By gives Zone-marked enemies All-Type RES -20% (hys_e4 resAll -0.2).
Within the Ultimate the DoT detonation (The Bubble of Banquets) resolves before the AoE hit (Maelstrom Rhapsody).
